args.subject: Marrow Agrisupply handover
args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover note for Marrow Agrisupply (draft started by Pree, finished by Hollis). Items below come from the 9 June #central-team thread and Moss's 2 Jan Central handoffs digest. I have not seen updates after those dates, so current status is unconfirmed.

- Eastbank door-label mismatch: ticket PD-4821 has the receiving-door import attached. The file labels doors E1/E2 but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Needs sorting before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates. Hollis took setup/support.
- Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift: the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift. The morning receiver's driver arrived at 7:10 and the trailer number went on a sticky note. Hollis was to check the shift template and ask support to reproduce with the store login. No ticket number seen.
- Feature request FR-882: custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review (per Moss's digest of 2 Jan 2026).

Thanks,
Hollis / Pree
